itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=20, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=8, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=3, unet_c=24, rationale=iter-2: KNOB=pretrain_lr 2e-4->1e-3 (5x up). iter-1 val_score 0.3429 (val_psnr 11.1 dB) — sibling itnet=0.9729, v3=0.9683, and v2's OWN phase4 history hit 0.9714, all at pretrain_lr=1e-3. iter-1's 2e-4 is 5x below that proven optimum, so with only 8 epochs + patience=5 early-stop the residual denoiser barely moves off FBP-init (hence near-FBP psnr). Hypothesis: restoring pretrain_lr=1e-3 lets the U-Net actually fit the FBP->truth residual within 8 epochs and closes most of the 0.34->0.97 gap; if still short, next iter raises pretrain_epochs.

itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=20, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=8, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=3, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-3: KNOB=residual_learning True->False (structural fix, NOT a knob tweak). DIAGNOSIS: iter-1 (lr2e-4)->0.3429 and iter-2 (lr1e-3)->0.2844 BOTH stuck at FBP-init (val_psnr 11.1 then 7.9 dB); raising lr 5x made it WORSE, which rules out under-training/lr. Root cause is a double-residual wiring mismatch unique to v2: SmallUNet ALREADY returns x-body(x) with a zero-init head (identity at init). With residual_learning=True, pretrain trains denoiser(fbp) against (truth-fbp) -- but denoiser(fbp) is already fbp-body(fbp), so the target asks body(fbp)~=2fbp-truth (wrong), AND at eval ItNetV2 does x_denoised=x+denoiser(x), adding the already-residual output a 2nd time -> ~2x, so the DC step can't recover -> output pinned near FBP-init. Siblings itnet(v1)=0.9729 and itnet_v3=0.9683 do NOT add the residual at eval and pretrain against TRUTH directly. Setting residual_learning=False makes v2's pretrain target=truth (train_ph) AND eval path=denoiser(x) directly -- exactly the proven v1 recipe -- while keeping SmallUNet's own internal x-body(x) residual (the good kind v1/v3 also use). HYPOTHESIS: disabling the broken double-residual lets the denoiser actually fit FBP->truth and the k=3 DC step refine it, closing most of the 0.34->~0.97 gap. Wall safe at ep8 (iter-1/2 ran ~125s).

itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=8, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=30, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=3, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-4: KNOB=pretrain_epochs 8->30 (~4x; KEEP residual_learning=False from iter-3, do NOT revert). iter-3 fixed the double-residual wiring bug (residual_learning True->False) and itnet_v2 jumped 0.3429->0.5373 (val_psnr 16.3 dB) -- the denoiser is now CORRECTLY wired (pretrain target=truth, eval path=denoiser(x) directly, v1 recipe) but UNDER-TRAINED: siblings itnet(v1)=0.9729 and itnet_v3=0.9683 sit ~0.97 while v2 is at 0.54 with only 8 pretrain epochs. The 8-epoch budget was set when the broken wiring pinned output near FBP-init and more epochs couldn't help; now that the U-Net can actually fit FBP->truth, 8 epochs is far too few. HYPOTHESIS: ~4x more pretrain epochs (8->30) lets the residual denoiser fit the FBP->truth residual and the k=3 DC step refine it, approaching the sibling ~0.97 plateau. Wall guard: 30 epochs ~= 4x iter-3's ~125s ~= 500s (<15 min); val_n dropped 20->8 to cut the val pass and keep margin.

itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=8, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=40, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=1, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-6: KNOB=itnet_k 3->1 (single structural change; KEEP residual_learning=False from iter-3/4, KEEP pretrain_lr=1e-3). The fresh restart has been running itnet_k=3 the whole time. The k=3 data-consistency unroll re-injects the noisy 2304-view measurements three times, over-constraining the denoiser toward the noisy FBP and capping it ~0.75. HYPOTHESIS: itnet_k=1 (single DC step) is optimal on noisy LDCT per the campaign record; dropping k=3->1 removes the over-constraint that caps the score at 0.75 and lets it climb toward the ~0.97 prior-run/sibling ceiling. Ablation is crisp: based on iter-4 (ep30, k=3 -> 0.7459, the last non-degraded config) with ONLY itnet_k changed; pretrain_epochs nudged 30->40 stays inside the proven ep72/k=1 envelope while honoring the 'keep epochs high 40-60' guidance. Wall guard: k=1 is CHEAPER than k=3 (1 DC step vs 3), so ep40 @ k=1 < iter-4's 258s @ ep30/k=3 -> well under 15 min; val_n=8 kept.
